title: Optimize vector batch update ownership
constraints: Preserve HNSW and legacy columnar vector search behavior
rationale: FusionStorage::update_columnar_store cloned the full ids and vectors batches to build the legacy columnar store before separately cloning entries into HNSW. Updating HNSW from borrowed input first and then moving the owned batches into ColumnarVectorStore removes the full-batch clone for the legacy path.
steps: Update HNSW from borrowed ids and vectors
Move owned ids and vectors into ColumnarVectorStore
Verify hybrid search and SQL HNSW ORDER BY behavior
expected_impact: Reduces allocation and clone work during batch vector store refreshes while preserving existing vector search semantics.
